```{=html}
<div class="cp-grid cp-grid--2-aside" style="min-height:62vh;align-items:center;color:#fff;">

        <circle id="BREAKID-ring" class="cp-timer__ring" cx="90" cy="90" r="75" fill="none" stroke="#EF7C00" stroke-width="14" stroke-dasharray="471.24" stroke-dashoffset="0" stroke-linecap="round" transform="rotate(-90 90 90)"></circle>
        <text id="BREAKID-text" class="cp-timer__text" x="90" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#00796B">05:00</text>
      </svg>
      <span id="BREAKID-status" role="timer" aria-live="polite" class="cp-sr-only">05:00</span>
      <button id="BREAKID-btn" type="button" class="cp-timer__button" data-cp-timer data-seconds="300" data-ring="BREAKID-ring" data-text="BREAKID-text" data-status="BREAKID-status">▶ Start Timer</button>

```

::: notes
Replace every `BREAKID` with a unique identifier, for example `w03-break`. The deck YAML must load `../cp-timer.html` through `include-after-body`. Start the timer when announcing the break; it pauses automatically if the slide is left.
:::
